## What changed

0.3.3 is in the index at `https://hotloop.io/hotloop-codesys/`, published on 2026-11-15. The provisioner is the same one 0.3.2 ran.

- **It wraps HotLoop 4.20.0.** The new web UI is the page at `/`, and an agent can change everything it can read through MCP, behind the write gate.

What it means for you: a box on 0.3.3 gets the new UI and the MCP tools with a chart upgrade and nothing else.

## What was checked

An upgrade from 0.3.1 with a profile applied to 0.3.3, beside a CODESYS Control for Linux SL 4.22.0.0 runtime: one new pod on 4.20.0 came up, the devices and their 2,232 tags were still there, and the listeners connected again.
